clauses: A fresh stand-in reads `state === Tailscale.NoState` and `writable === true`
Each of its five actions of #286 records one call and changes no property
With `exitNodeActive` true and `exitNodeOnline` false, `exitNodeBlocked` reads true; `issueCount` is the length of `issues`
On `peers` with three rows, `setProperty`, `move`, `insert` and `remove` each emit their row signal and no `modelReset`
`clear()` leaves 0 rows, and refilling after it gives every row a new delegate
